summary: Playbooks run top to bottom; each play needs a host pattern and at least one task. Example: one play updates httpd with ansible.builtin.yum and template on webservers, another updates and starts postgresql on databases. Use FQCNs because collections can share module names.
questions: Why should I use FQCN for modules in playbooks?
How do I target web and database servers in one playbook?
What is the minimum a play needs?
Example of a multi-play Ansible playbook
